en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a modernist residential and commercial complex with flat‑roofed apartment blocks and a distinctive low angular building with deep concrete fins and terraces in the foreground. The scene includes landscaped gardens, streets and sidewalks, and low hills in the background. The reverse side has printed Hungarian text, an area for a stamp, and address lines.
